verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that editing a manual journal entry automatically creates a voiding (reversing) entry and posts a new one. That preserves a record of what changed for manual journal entries, but nothing in the pack describes a ledger-wide audit log. missing for 10: user attribution (who made each change), timestamps (when), an audit trail covering all ledger activity beyond manual journal entries, an audit-log view or export, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
